title: Dashboard dependency chain visualization
description: Update project-dashboard.js to include dependency chain information for each backlog item: parent_id, children (list of child IDs), depends_on_status (array of { id, status } for each dependency), blocked_by_deps (list of dependency IDs that are not done), is_blocked_by_parent (boolean). Update project-dashboard.output.schema.json with the new fields. All fields are computed read-only, never mutating the filesystem.
stop_condition: Dashboard output includes parent-child relationships and dependency status for each item. Schema enforced. Tests pass.
